text:
maria: Heads-up — nightly perf CI flagged a p95 regression on the small-batch suite for runtime v2.3.7 vs v2.3.6, started ~00:12 UTC. p95 jumped from ~120ms to ~260ms on gpu-optimized nodes. logging: https://internal.ci/reports/4901237890

aj: pinging ops/oncall — can we hold new deploys to the pool? :eyes:

sre-bot: @oncall alerted — flag created (INC-2026-4901). Autoscaler unaffected.

maria: repro steps I ran: 
```
benchctl run nightly --suite small-batch --variant gpu-optimized --model rwd-13b --runs 5
# summary output:
# v2.3.6: p50=40ms p95=120ms p99=220ms
# v2.3.7: p50=55ms p95=260ms p99=480ms
```

dennis: thanks. can you dump kernel logs + runtime config? curious if continuous-batching changed defaults.

maria: posted snippets below (trimmed). config diff looks like: changed batching.window_ms  -> 10 from 5 and kv_cache.eviction_policy default changed.

lucy: eviction change might explain cache churn — did you see higher backend disk IO?

maria: yep, IO spikes on the same runs, see extraction: 
```
I/O summary: read_ops/sec spike 5x at 00:13
Runtime logs show KV cache miss rate ~0.48 -> 0.73
Trace snippet: shard=2 request_id=abc123 latency=258ms path=kv/cache/fetch
```

pranav: if kv miss increased, we could be falling back to slower path. can we run with kv_cache.eviction_policy=old and batching.window_ms=5 on a repro node?

aj: I can repro quickly on a staging reserved node, starting now. will tag results.

deploy-bot: Deploys paused: rolling updates to runtime-v2.3.7 halted (reason: perf-alert).

maria: thanks. also noticed model variant fallback occurred for ~2% of requests (auto-fallback to quantized variant) — that should not happen for small-batch workload.

dennis: good catch. looks like the routing policy changed in the new release (fallback threshold lowered). that combined with cache churn = p95 impact.

lucy: action plan suggestion: (1) block new v2.3.7 rollouts, (2) run targeted repro with old cache/ batching flags, (3) revert routing/fallback threshold in canary, (4) collect a 30m trace.

maria: +1. I can run step 2 and upload traces. estimated 20–30m.

aj: repro done on staging: with old flags p95=118ms. with v2.3.7 defaults p95=255ms. attaching short log blob: https://internal.ci/artifacts/4901237890/logs.gz

pranav: great repro. I'll draft a rollback PR for the routing change and include the fallback threshold tweak.

maria: tagging folks for handoff: @aj please update this thread when you confirm rollback is staged. @pranav please paste PR link when ready. @dennis can you own the postmortem if we merge revert?

aj: staging revert applied, smoke looks green. will schedule a controlled canary rollback window for next 10m then promote if stable.

pranav: PR: https://git.internal/runtime/changes/PR-1429 — includes revert + test that asserts fallback rate < 0.5% for small-batch.

dennis: ack, I'll own the postmortem and start a timeline doc. pls add any trace links to the doc.

maria: added trace + repro commands to the timeline doc. thanks everyone.

sre-bot: Incident INC-2026-4901 status updated -> mitigated (canary rollback in progress).

aj: rollback to v2.3.6 promoted to 20% canary, p95 back to ~125ms, no disk IO spike. moving to 100% in 5m if no regressions. :thumbsup:

maria: nice work. postmortem notes: consider making kv eviction policy change behind a flag and add an explicit perf gate for routing fallback thresholds.

pranav: agreed. will add to the PR/issue.

lucy: leaving a quick runbook note in /runbooks/perf/kv-eviction.md about this pattern.

maria: closing the loop here — I'll mark this thread resolved once the rollback is fully promoted and PMs notified.

aj: rollback promoted to 100%. time now 00:47 UTC. marking resolved from ops side.

maria: resolved. thanks all. :sparkles:
